commands.description: fetch next page — more of the same ranking: re-send your previous search body unchanged (query, filters, context, limit) with pagination.cursor set to result.pagination.cursor, copied verbatim; cursors are opaque and may invalidate across inventory changes; if results are weak or off-target, change query/context.intent instead and omit the cursor

cta.description: Extensions: shopify catalog extension active — responses may carry shop-specific enrichment beyond the core spec; `variants[*].url` is the PDP and `variants[*].checkout_url` is the buy-now target; discount extension advertised — cart/checkout may accept `discount_codes[]` and surface `discount_allocations` per line item; run --input-schema before adding discount fields; fulfillment extension advertised — delivery groups may carry richer scheduling/handle metadata than the core spec requires; run --input-schema before adding fulfillment fields. Cross-business results — each variant belongs to its own seller. Pick the seller AND variant the buyer wants (products[N].variants[M]) before proceeding. To create a cart, pass --business=<products[N].variants[M].seller.domain>. If chosen items span multiple seller.domain values, create one cart/checkout per seller. Buyer handoff: open products[N].variants[M].checkout_url for buy-now handoff when the buyer wants business-hosted checkout. More results available; paginate only if you need them.

description.html: Delve into our Robot Sensors collection to discover a range of versatile sensors designed to enhance the functionality of your robotic projects. Our selection features sensor modules such as accelerometers, ultrasonic sensors, infrared sensors, and more, enabling precise measurements from orientation and distance to temperature and humidity. These sensors are essential for achieving accurate data collection and seamless interaction with the environment, making them ideal for robotics enthusiasts and professionals seeking reliable and advanced sensing solutions.

Our selection of temperature and humidity sensors offers reliable solutions for precise environmental monitoring. These sensors are designed to measure a wide range of conditions, from basic temperature and humidity levels to advanced parameters like dew point and air quality. With options supporting various communication protocols such as UART, I2C, and LoRaWAN, these sensors are versatile and suitable for applications in agriculture, weather stations, and indoor air monitoring, ensuring accurate and consistent performance.

Description BME280 Breakout Sensor Measures Temperature, Pressure and Humidity Versatile indoor/outdoor environmental monitoring Compatible with Raspberry Pi, Arduino, and Raspberry Pi Pico Features Bosch BME280 sensor for accurate measurements Easy integration with I2C interface and Qwiic/STEMMA QT connector The BME280 Breakout Sensor: Temperature, Pressure, Humidity is an excellent environmental sensor designed for indoor monitoring of temperature, pressure, and humidity. The BME280 Breakout features a Bosch BME280 temperature, pressure, and humidity sensor, an I2C interface, a Qwiic/STEMMA QT connector, and compatibility with both 3.3V and 5V power supplies. Additionally, it offers reverse polarity protection and is compatible with Raspberry Pi, Arduino, and Raspberry Pi Pico. Description DFRobot BMP280 Digital Pressure Sensor Module V1.0 Offers the highest flexibility to optimize the device Features high EMO robustness Communication through I2C Low Power Consumption Communication Interface: I2C (5 V compatible) The DFRobot BMP280 Digital Pressure Sensor Module V1.0 is a breakout version of the BMP280 Barometric Pressure Sensor from the DFRobot with temperature and pressure measurement functions, supporting Arduino code control. The BMP280 is based on Bosch’s proven Piezo-resistive pressure sensor technology featuring high EMO robustness, high accuracy and linearity, and long term stability. Numerous device operation options offer the highest flexibility to optimize the device regarding power consumption, resolution, and filter performance. Barometric sensors are usually used to measure barometric pressure and temperature. But besides that, they can also measure altitude and relative floor height due to the fact that there is a certain relationship between altitude and barometric pressure. As for navigation, the barometric pressure sensor can be used to enhance GPS positioning or realize 3D indoor navigation with the IMU sensor. Description Air Quality Sensor Combo Board by Velleman Senses the atmospheric-quality Provides a variety of environmental data Communication protocol: I2C Operation Voltage: 3.3 V Humidity Range: 0-100% RH The Velleman Air Quality Sensor Combo Board senses the atmospheric quality by using the popular CCS811 and BME280 ICs. It provides a variety of environmental data including barometric pressure, humidity, temperature, TVOCs, and equivalent CO2 (or eCO2) levels. Communication is possible through the I2C protocol. The CCS811 is an exceedingly popular sensor, providing readings for equivalent CO2 (or eCO2) in parts per million (PPM) and total volatile organic compounds in the parts per billion (PPB). The CCS811 also has a feature that allows it to fine-tune its readings if it has access to the current humidity and temperature. Description BMP280 Temperature, Pressure, Altitude Sensor Breakout Board Features a temperature, pressure, and altitude sensor Is compatible with 3.3 V or 5 V Offers reverse polarity protection Compatible with Raspberry Pi 3B+, 3, 2, B+, A+, Zero, and Zero W The BMP280 Temperature, Pressure, Altitude Sensor Breakout Board is a fast and precise environmental sensor that can measure temperature, pressure, and altitude. The BMP280 breakout is Raspberry Pi and Arduino-compatible. If you're looking for a simple temperature and pressure sensor, then this is the one to pick. It's cheap and accurate (±1 hPa, ±1 °C, ±1 meter), and ideal for keeping track of temperatures around your home or even for measuring altitude in high-altitude balloon flights.
